articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring significantly improved chain-of-thought reasoning, native image and audio generation, and a larger context window reaching 1M tokens. The model demonstrates substantial gains on graduate-level science benchmarks and complex multi-step coding tasks, narrowing the gap between AI assistants and domain experts in several fields.

articles.title: Google DeepMind Unveils Gemini 2.5 Ultra with Breakthrough Agentic Capabilities
articles.summary: Google DeepMind released Gemini 2.5 Ultra, emphasizing autonomous multi-step task completion across Google Workspace and third-party APIs. The model can independently research, draft, and execute complex workflows with human-in-the-loop checkpoints, representing a major step toward production-grade AI agents in enterprise environments.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Limited Deployment in Automotive Factories
articles.summary: Tesla has started deploying its third-generation Optimus humanoid robots in select Gigafactory production lines for material handling and quality inspection tasks. The Gen 3 units feature improved dexterous manipulation with 22 degrees of freedom per hand and onboard vision-language models for real-time task adaptation without explicit reprogramming.

articles.title: Figure AI Raises $1.5B Series C to Scale Humanoid Robot Manufacturing
articles.summary: Figure AI closed a $1.5 billion Series C round led by Microsoft and Bezos Expeditions, valuing the company at over $15 billion. The funding will go toward building a dedicated manufacturing facility in South Carolina and scaling production of its Figure 03 humanoid, which has been piloting warehouse logistics tasks with BMW and Amazon.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude Tool-Use Mesh for Multi-Agent Orchestration
articles.summary: Anthropic launched a new multi-agent orchestration framework that allows multiple Claude instances to collaborate on complex tasks with shared memory, role specialization, and conflict resolution protocols. Early benchmarks show the mesh architecture outperforming single-agent approaches by 40% on large-scale software engineering and research synthesis tasks.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm Process Node Ahead of Schedule
articles.summary: TSMC announced that its N1.4 process node has entered high-volume manufacturing at its Kaohsiung fab, several months ahead of the originally projected timeline. The node delivers a 20% performance improvement and 30% power reduction over N2, with Apple and Nvidia confirmed as lead customers for chips expected in early 2027 devices.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Clearance for Second-Generation Brain-Computer Interface
articles.summary: Neuralink obtained FDA approval to begin broader clinical trials with its N2 implant, which doubles the electrode count to 2,048 channels and introduces bidirectional stimulation capabilities. The approval follows positive results from its initial cohort of paralysis patients who demonstrated high-bandwidth cursor control and text input exceeding 60 words per minute.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics and Hyundai Deploy Autonomous Construction Robot Fleet in Seoul
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics, in partnership with Hyundai Engineering, deployed a fleet of Atlas electric humanoid robots and Spot quadrupeds on a commercial high-rise construction site in Seoul. The robots autonomously perform rebar inspection, site surveying, and heavy material transport, coordinated by a centralized fleet management system that reduces project timeline estimates by 15%.
